headings.usage: Use for all page titles, hero text, and primary metric numbers.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, form inputs, and buttons.

layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto relative min-h-[100dvh] bg-slate-50 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl

bottom_sheet.style: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white rounded-t-3xl shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] z-50 transform transition-transform duration-300
bottom_sheet.usage: Primary navigation and interaction pattern for order creation, driver details, and address input.

map_background.usage: Simulation of map background when actual map integration is not present or loading.

button.primary: w-full bg-primary text-white font-semibold py-4 px-6 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all active:scale-[0.98] flex items-center justify-center gap-2
button.secondary: w-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 font-semibold py-4 px-6 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-200 transition-all active:scale-[0.98] flex items-center justify-center gap-2
button.icon: w-12 h-12 bg-white text-slate-900 rounded-full shadow-md flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-slate-50

input_field.input: w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 rounded-xl px-4 py-4 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all outline-none
input_field.label: block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-2

card.style: bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-slate-100

animations.pulse_dot: animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-primary opacity-20

accessibility.contrast_requirements: All text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1). Do not place white text on light green buttons.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. E.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn', data-testid='order-address-input'.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all mobile action buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. For the WebToApp mobile simulation, wrap the main `<App />` layout in a container with `max-w-md mx-auto min-h-[100dvh] relative overflow-hidden bg-slate-50`. This creates the phone form-factor on desktop, and native feel on mobile.
2. Implement the Map Background using the CSS grid utility provided in components.map_background.
3. Role selection and Login should use clean card-based options. Add a phone verification mock step (input digits).
4. Heavy use of Bottom Sheets. The customer 'Order ride' screen should be a map background with a persistent bottom sheet containing the address inputs.
5. Use `lucide-react` icons (e.g. MapPin, Navigation, Car, Menu, User).
6. Admin panel can break out of the mobile container (`max-w-7xl` instead of `max-w-md`) since admins use desktop.
7. Include OneSignal mock toggles or API setting inputs in the Admin screen.
8. MANDATORY: Ensure EVERY interactive element has `data-testid`.
